rationale: Tests understanding of the web of determinants of community health status covered in block 4, requiring learners to distinguish distal social determinants from proximate biomedical factors.
Tests recall of the six-step systematic community diagnosis process covered in block 7, specifically the correct sequence of defining the community before data collection.
Tests recall of the eight essential elements of Primary Health Care as defined in the Alma-Ata Declaration 1978, a core factual requirement of CM17.3.
Tests understanding of National Health Policy 2017 targets versus the older NPP 2000, requiring learners to apply knowledge of India's policy commitments covered in block 7.
Tests recall of population coverage norms for Sub-Centre, PHC, and CHC in India's rural public healthcare delivery hierarchy — a standard Park's textbook fact for CM17.5.
Tests understanding of the WHO 2007 health system building blocks framework applied to India, specifically whether 'health information' is one of the six blocks — covered in block 7.
